report.summary: All four UI tests fail with 5 s Playwright timeouts, and they share one root cause: the app's `slow_list` seeded bug makes `list_books` sleep a random 0-8 s, and every failing step waits on a page that renders that list (`GET /books`, or the POST/redirect to `/books`). Treat this as flaky timing, not four separate product bugs. First, make sure the UI run does not enable `BUGS=slow_list` (the CI workflow doesn't set it, so confirm where this run's env came from), or make the delay deterministic for the suite.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s delay in list_books exceeds the 5 s Playwright timeout
causes.explanation: With BUGS containing slow_list, app/main.py:160-161 calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) on every book listing. list_books is called from books_page (GET /books, via render_books at line 270) and from the POST /books error path (render_books). The browser's page.goto('/books') waits for the load event, and the form submit click waits for the redirect target to load. The fail_fast fixture in tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7 caps every wait at 5000 ms, so any draw above 5 s (about 3/8 of draws) fails. The four failing tests are exactly the ones that wait on that render. Other tests that also load /books (for example test_existing_user_can_log_in, test_deleted_book_disappears) passed in this run, which fits a random delay. The fixture comment says 'Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s', which this bug violates. The fix is to take the random delay out of the UI run, or to make it fixed and well under the timeout, or to fix the app's slow path. Keep the flake marked as a known issue until then. The test code itself is reasonable.
evidence: tests/ui/test_books_ui.py: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:64649/books", waiting until "load" (test_added_book_is_listed, via tests/support/pages.py:34 open())
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded, navigating to ".../books" waiting until "load" (test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui, via pages.py:34)

tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:9 Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' after clicking get_by_test_id("submit") on /register (the register POST redirects to /books, which renders the list)
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:42 Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' after clicking add-book (POST /books re-renders via render_books on error)
app/main.py:269-270: render_books calls list_books(user["id"]) on every books page render
app/main.py:12 docstring: 'slow_list random 0-8 s delay when listing books (flaky timing)'
Workflow .github/workflows/tests.yml does not set BUGS, so the delay is only active if this environment sets BUGS=slow_list; the traceback paths (C:\Users\...) show this was not the ubuntu CI runner
causes.suggested_fix: Run the UI suite without BUGS=slow_list (or with it set to a fixed short delay). If the slow path is meant to be tested, give it its own test with a longer timeout, or make the bug deterministic. Optionally raise the fail_fast timeout for pages that render lists. Rerun the four tests several times to confirm they pass when the delay is absent.
